$comment: ACM type:style -> the wp-ja-impact pattern that renders it, field by field, for the seeder (renderAcm, `${type}:${style}`). Field names are the Joomla ACM field names verbatim (plus the fields the task's spec steps add, tasks/ja-impact-wp7/tools/spec-steps). metadata.name is <type>.<field>[.<n>]; the wrapper of a repeated row is <type>.item.<n>. A block is located by name, never by position. Fragments live in tasks/ja-impact-wp7/map/*.json, one owner each; tools/build-map.mjs composes this file.
